# Rebuild Answers

> We measure whether AI answer engines actually recommend a brand, by asking them, and then
> fix what's losing. Most tools in this category infer visibility from page structure; we run
> the client's real buyer questions through live engines and record the answers verbatim.

Rebuild Answers is a generative engine optimization agency in Florida.

**What we are not:** not an SEO agency in the traditional sense — we do not sell link building,
keyword rankings, or content volume. Not a software product; the tooling is free and open
source and you are welcome to run it without us. Not a reseller of any third-party AI
visibility dashboard.

Prices are public and stated as numbers, not "contact us": $2,400 one-off, $5,800/mo retainer,
$3,200 agent-surface audit. As of 20 August 2026.

## Original data

- [The Answer Index](https://rebuildanswers.com/answer-index.html): standing share-of-answer readings by
  category, published with the prompt set, run count, engine, and date.
  **Status as of 22 September 2026: no readings published yet.** The page is live and states
  this plainly rather than showing invented numbers. First entries follow the first published
  read.

## Contact

- hello@rebuildanswers.com — send a domain and the competitors that matter.

## Facts

- Florida, United States.
- Engagements run against a frozen, versioned prompt set. Share of answer is share of that set.
- Probes run 3x per prompt against one named engine, currently claude-opus-5 with web search.
- Every engagement opens with the one-off read. Nobody starts on the retainer.
- The 6-month minimum applies to the retainer only, because off-site work takes 3-6 months
  to show up in answers.
- We do not model prompt volume. Ahrefs and Semrush model it from search demand at a scale we
  cannot match; we build prompt sets from first-party evidence and cite the evidence instead.
- We do not astroturf, buy reviews, or suppress accurate criticism.
